newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 index loses 0.43 pct to 489.0 pts.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 index loses 0.43 pct to 489.0 pts.

text.p: 1410 GMT - Losses to the heaviest Prague Stock Exchange issues drag the bourse main index down in quiet trading. * PX50 index closes 2.1 points, or 0.43 percent, lower at 489.0 points. * Komercni Banka falls 37 crowns to 1,680. * SPT Telecom down 15 crowns to 3,400. * CEZ recovers from early losses, closes unchanged at 895. * Overall on the bourse, 103 issues gain, 84 fall, 66 unchanged. * A total of 490,876 shares traded on turnover of 338.1 million crowns.
